# Lab 11.2: Continuous Query → Pub/Sub

## What We Are Going to Do
Run a continuous query that sends every high-fare ride to a Pub/Sub topic as soon as it lands in BigQuery (reverse ETL).

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Create the topic and a pull subscription.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud pubsub topics create high-fare-rides
gcloud pubsub subscriptions create high-fare-sub --topic=high-fare-rides</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[Console] Write the continuous query.** In a new tab, click **More → Continuous query mode**. In **Query settings**, set **Service account** to `bq-continuous@…`. Paste (replace `YOUR_PROJECT`):


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">EXPORT DATA
OPTIONS (
  format = 'CLOUD_PUBSUB',
  uri = 'https://pubsub.googleapis.com/projects/YOUR_PROJECT/topics/high-fare-rides'
) AS
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(STRUCT(ride_id, city, fare, ride_ts)) AS message
FROM APPENDS(TABLE lab11.rides, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE)
WHERE fare &gt; 150;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Click **Run**. The job keeps running.

3. **[CLI] The same query from the CLI.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq query --use_legacy_sql=false --continuous=true \
  --connection_property=service_account=bq-continuous@$PROJECT_ID.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  "EXPORT DATA OPTIONS (format='CLOUD_PUBSUB', uri='https://pubsub.googleapis.com/projects/$PROJECT_ID/topics/high-fare-rides') AS
   SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(STRUCT(ride_id, city, fare)) AS message
   FROM APPENDS(TABLE lab11.rides, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE) WHERE fare &gt; 150"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Run only one of the two.

4. **[CLI] Generate rides and read the messages.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">./gen_rides.sh
gcloud pubsub subscriptions pull high-fare-sub --auto-ack --limit=10</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **[Console] Cancel the query.** Open the running job in **Personal history** and click **Cancel**.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Trigger | New rows in `lab11.rides` |
| Filter | Only `fare > 150` |
| Output | JSON messages in Pub/Sub within seconds |
| Job | Runs until you cancel it |
